The video title is confirmed, but the page text lacks the count. I’m extracting the video’s available captions locally to verify the maximum simultaneous species.
```python
caption_command = await run_command("python -c \"import urllib.request; u='https://www.youtube.com/api/timedtext?v=L1vXCYZAYYM&lang=en'; r=urllib.request.urlopen(u, timeout=20); print(r.read().decode('utf-8','ignore'))\"")
print(caption_command)
```
The standard caption endpoint did not provide the answer, so I’m querying YouTube’s player metadata for caption-track URLs and will inspect any available track.
```python
player_command = await run_command("python -c \"import urllib.request; u='https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?key=AIzaSyAO_FJ2SlqU8Q4STEHLGCilK5R8o3fJ4'; body=b'{\\\"context\\\":{\\\"client\\\":{\\\"clientName\\\":\\\"ANDROID\\\",\\\"clientVersion\\\":\\\"19.09.37\\\"}},\\\"videoId\\\":\\\"L1vXCYZAYYM\\\"}'; req=urllib.request.Request(u, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}); print(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read().decode('utf-8','ignore'))\"")
print(player_command)
```
I’m also checking transcript aggregators by the confirmed title, since this wildlife clip may have an autogenerated narration transcript.
```python
title_search = await web_search('"Penguin Chicks Stand Up To Giant Petrel" transcript', max_results=10)
print(title_search)
```
The direct transcript lookup is inconclusive; I’m checking the video’s alternate language-caption endpoint, which often exposes autogenerated captions when the English endpoint is empty.
```python
caption_alt = await web_fetch("https://www.youtube.com/api/timedtext?v=L1vXCYZAYYM&lang=en&kind=asr", max_chars=30000)
print(caption_alt)
```
Three bird species.
